# STDPDrivenGraphLearning

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A learning paradigm where STDP rules are applied to graph-structured inputs, enabling unsupervised feature extraction from network topology. Reduces reliance on labeled data and backpropagation, making it suitable for in-network learning on resource-constrained neuromorphic hardware.
